title: SCTCC Academic Calendar dates for syllabi
instructions: Dates use yyyy-mm-dd. "status": "sample" = placeholder dates; "published" = copied from the published academic calendar but not yet confirmed by Records & Registration; "official" = confirmed. Set a term's "verified" to true once Records & Registration has confirmed it. The published calendar does not list add/drop/withdrawal deadlines (they vary by course and are shown in eServices), so lastDayToDrop and lastDayToWithdraw are left blank. No-class dates list only days without classes that fall between a term's startDate and endDate; labels are copied from the published calendar.
